ai.title: ZenaTech Completes Acquisition of ESM Software, Adding Strategy Execution and Compliance Software to its Enterprise SaaS Division, with Revenue from Government, Healthcare and Financial Services Custo
ai.description: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Aug. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ZenaTech, Inc. (Nasdaq: ZENA) (FSE: 49Q) (BMV: ZENA) ('ZenaTech”), a technology solution provider specializing in AI (Artificial Intelligence) drones, Drone as a Service (DaaS), enterprise SaaS, and Quantum Computing solutions, announces the acquisition of ESM Software, a Boston-based strategy execution and performance management software company. ESM serves government, school systems, healthcare, utilities and energy, financial services and retail customers across the United States and globally in Latin America, Europe, Africa, and Australia. In operation since 1998, the company now supports over 120,000 users and has spent more than 25 years helping organizations turn strategic plans into measurable results. This 13th addition to the company’s SaaS portfolio of software brands provides important value to its growing platform and adds recurring revenue and long-standing, multi-year customer relationships.
ai.title_cn: ZenaTech完成对ESM Software的收购，将战略执行和合规软件添加到其企业SaaS部门，收入来自政府、医疗保健和金融服务Custo
ai.description_cn: 不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华，2026年8月25日（环球新闻网）-- ZenaTech，Inc.（纳斯达克：ZENA）（FSE：49 Q）（BMV：ZENA）（“ZenaTech”）是一家专注于AI（人工智能）无人机、无人机即服务（DaSaaS）、企业SaaS和量子计算解决方案的技术解决方案提供商，宣布收购总部位于波士顿的战略执行和绩效管理软件公司ESM Software。ESM为美国以及拉丁美洲、欧洲、非洲和澳大利亚的政府、学校系统、医疗保健、公用事业和能源、金融服务和零售客户提供服务。该公司自1998年运营以来，目前支持超过120，000名用户，并花了25年多的时间帮助组织将战略计划转化为可衡量的结果。该公司SaaS软件品牌组合的第13个成员为其不断增长的平台提供了重要价值，并增加了经常性收入和长期的多年客户关系。
